# mailchannels_check_domain (Data Source)

Checks that a domain's SPF, DKIM, Domain Lockdown and sender-domain DNS records let it send through MailChannels. Use it in a `check` block or a postcondition to verify DNS after provisioning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailchannels_check_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "mailchannels_ready" {
  value = data.mailchannels_check_domain.example.all_passed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Sending domain to check.

### Optional

- `dkim_settings` (Attributes List) MailChannels-managed DKIM keys to check, at most 10. Defaults to every stored key for `domain`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_settings))
- `envelope_from_domain` (String) Envelope-from domain, when it differs from `domain`; SPF and Domain Lockdown are checked against it.
- `sender_id` (String) Sender ID used for Domain Lockdown, as sent in `X-MailChannels-SenderId`.

### Read-Only

- `all_passed` (Boolean) True when SPF, every DKIM check, Domain Lockdown and the sender-domain check passed.
- `dkim` (Attributes List) One result per DKIM key checked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim))
- `domain_lockdown_reason` (String) Explanation of the Domain Lockdown verdict.
- `domain_lockdown_verdict` (String) Domain Lockdown verdict, `passed` or `failed`.
- `id` (String) The domain.
- `references` (List of String) Links to documentation for any check that did not pass.
- `sender_domain_verdict` (String) Whether the domain has the A or MX record MailChannels needs, `passed` or `failed`.
- `spf_reason` (String) Explanation of the SPF verdict.
- `spf_record` (String) SPF record that was checked.
- `spf_verdict` (String) SPF verdict, such as `passed`, `failed` or `soft failed`.

<a id="nestedatt--dkim_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dkim_settings`

Optional:

- `dkim_domain` (String) Signing domain (`d=`). Defaults to `domain`.
- `dkim_selector` (String) Selector of a stored key. All stored keys when omitted.


<a id="nestedatt--dkim"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dkim`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Signing domain.
- `key_status` (String) Status of the MailChannels-managed key.
- `reason` (String) Explanation.
- `selector` (String) Selector.
- `verdict` (String) `passed` or `failed`.
